## Task 2 · Landing on the floor (3 marks)

A player jumps down onto a floor with the velocity v = (5, −3). The floor
has the unit normal n = (0, 1).

a) Compute v · n. Does the player move into the floor? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
